findings_addressed.oracle: Round-trip through get_memory_usage compared against a hint (65536) chosen to differ from the native default chunk size (4*1024*1024) hardcoded in src/intellicrack-hexcore/src/lib.rs:80; equality forces the native set_chunk_size_hint/get_chunk_size_hint store-and-fetch to have run.

Round-trip through get_memory_usage compared against a budget (1 MiB) chosen to differ from the native default memory budget (512*1024*1024) hardcoded in src/intellicrack-hexcore/src/lib.rs:81; equality forces the native set_memory_budget_hint/get_memory_budget_hint store-and-fetch to have run.

usage_bytes recomputed independently from the on-disk file size via Path.stat().st_size (len of a 1024-byte payload), and chunk_size verified against a non-default value (32768) set via set_chunk_size beforehand; native document_size() must run for usage to be 1024 and the getter path must run for chunk_size to be 32768 rather than the 0 default.
